nodes.catchy_title: How small clues can expose stealth logic

nodes.label: F 117 Secrecy
nodes.full_label: Why the F 117 had to stay invisible | Special Access Progr A1 C931 Stealth Aircraft Sap
nodes.catchy_title: Why the F 117 had to stay invisible
nodes.summary: The F-117 shows why an aircraft's public absence can be protected as carefully as its technical drawings.

nodes.label: Tacit Blue
nodes.full_label: The strange aircraft that changed stealth | Special Access Progr A1 C931 Stealth Aircraft Sap
nodes.catchy_title: The strange aircraft that changed stealth
nodes.summary: Tacit Blue shows that stealth secrecy protected design methods, not just individual aircraft shapes.

nodes.label: Tonopah
nodes.full_label: Why Tonopah was more than a runway | Special Access Progr A1 C931 Stealth Aircraft Sap
nodes.catchy_title: Why Tonopah was more than a runway
nodes.summary: Tonopah made the F-117 harder to observe by separating testing, pilots and routines from ordinary fighter-base life.

nodes.label: Unacknowledged
nodes.full_label: When Even the Program Name Is Secret | Special Access Progr
nodes.catchy_title: When Even the Program Name Is Secret
nodes.summary: Unacknowledged SAPs protect the fact of a program's existence, not just the information inside it.

nodes.label: Congress Oversight
nodes.full_label: How Oversight Works When Names Are Hidden | Special Access Progr A1 C931 Unacknowledged Saps
nodes.catchy_title: How Oversight Works When Names Are Hidden
nodes.summary: Unacknowledged status does not remove congressional reporting, but it can narrow who receives details and how much is disclosed.

nodes.label: Hidden Existence
nodes.full_label: Why Existence Can Be the Secret | Special Access Progr A1 C931 Unacknowledged Saps
nodes.catchy_title: Why Existence Can Be the Secret
nodes.summary: A programme's name, sponsor, funding trail or test site can reveal capability clues even when no technical details are public.

nodes.label: Hidden Funding
nodes.full_label: What Secret Budgets Can Accidentally Reveal | Special Access Progr A1 C931 Unacknowledged Saps
nodes.catchy_title: What Secret Budgets Can Accidentally Reveal
nodes.summary: Funding can reveal scale, maturity and sponsorship, so unacknowledged programmes may hide or disconnect budget traces.

nodes.full_label: When Rumor Still Is Not Acknowledgment | Special Access Progr A1 C931 Unacknowledged Saps
nodes.catchy_title: When Rumor Still Is Not Acknowledgment
nodes.summary: Rumours, press reports and leaked claims can make a programme discussed without making it officially acknowledged.

nodes.full_label: Waived Is Not the Same as Hidden | Special Access Progr A1 C931 Unacknowledged Saps
nodes.catchy_title: Waived Is Not the Same as Hidden
nodes.summary: Waived and unacknowledged are different secrecy tools, and confusing them can distort claims about legality and oversight.

nodes.label: Who Can Confirm
nodes.full_label: Who Is Allowed to Say It Exists? | Special Access Progr A1 C931 Unacknowledged Saps
nodes.catchy_title: Who Is Allowed to Say It Exists?
nodes.summary: Knowing about a programme is not the same as having authority to confirm it, especially when existence is inside the compartment.

nodes.label: Waived SAPs
nodes.full_label: What Waived SAPs Really Hide | Special Access Progr
nodes.catchy_title: What Waived SAPs Really Hide
nodes.summary: Waived SAPs are not outside oversight, but they move the reporting path into a much smaller congressional channel.

nodes.full_label: Why do so few lawmakers hear details? | Special Access Progr A1 C931 Waived Saps
nodes.catchy_title: Why do so few lawmakers hear details?

nodes.catchy_title: Secrecy does not fix program failure
nodes.summary: GAO's 1993 review showed that SAP secrecy did not prevent familiar acquisition problems such as weak controls and cost growth.

nodes.catchy_title: When secrecy controls outgrow accountability
nodes.summary: The Moynihan Commission framed waived SAPs as part of a broader secrecy problem: access controls can protect secrets while weakening accountability.

nodes.full_label: What gets lost when reporting narrows? | Special Access Progr A1 C931 Waived Saps
nodes.catchy_title: What gets lost when reporting narrows?
nodes.summary: Waived reporting keeps Congress formally notified, but it can sharply reduce who can test costs, legality, duplication, and performance.

nodes.label: Staff Limits
nodes.full_label: Why staff access can decide oversight | Special Access Progr A1 C931 Waived Saps
nodes.catchy_title: Why staff access can decide oversight
nodes.summary: When staff access shrinks, the people most able to compare budgets, records, and program claims may be pushed out of the loop.

nodes.label: Waiver Test
nodes.full_label: How hard is the waiver test? | Special Access Progr A1 C931 Waived Saps
nodes.catchy_title: How hard is the waiver test?
nodes.summary: The waiver standard is meant to prevent blanket secrecy by tying each reporting exclusion to a specific national-security risk.
